value.name: will assigns house to Rosa
value.description: The will states that the house goes to Rosa Delacruz because she remained in residence and provided care.
evidence: the house was to go to Rosa Delacruz, who had remained in residence and provided care

value.name: will leaves remainder to Daniel and sister
value.description: The will gives Daniel the remainder of the estate in equal share with his sister.
evidence: Daniel to receive the remainder of the estate in equal share with his sister

value.name: Rosa watches Daniel silently
value.description: Rosa remains still at the foot of the stairs, staring at Daniel without moving.
evidence: Rosa had not shifted her weight or her eyes; she kept her gaze on Daniel
At the foot of the stairs Rosa held her place, her eyes still on Daniel

value.name: Daniel hesitates at the stairs
value.description: Daniel keeps his hand at his neck and does not try to move past Rosa toward the stairs.
evidence: Daniel, his hand still at his neck, did not try to step around her toward the climb

value.name: Asha closes folder and descends
value.description: Asha closes the blue folder, presses it against the bank statements, and comes down from the attic without looking back.
evidence: Asha closed the blue folder over the loose page, pressed it flat against the bank statements under her arm, and ducked back beneath the slope of the ceiling without a glance at the shelf or the coats that had kept its shape
She came down the second flight evenly

value.name: Asha avoids Daniel and attic
value.description: As she descends, Asha avoids looking at the attic door or Daniel waiting in the hall.
evidence: did not look up at the attic door behind her or down at Daniel waiting in the hall

value.name: Rosa retrieves and folds towel
value.description: Rosa reaches back for the towel she left on the table and folds it carefully along its old creases.
evidence: only when Asha reached the half-landing did she reach back to the table for the towel she had left there, folding it once and then again along its old creases

value.name: Daniel notices folder and Rosa's gesture
value.description: Daniel sees Asha's folder and Rosa's precise towel-folding, while his own posture remains tense and fixed.
evidence: Daniel saw the folder under Asha's arm and the small, exact motion of Rosa's hands and kept his own hand at his neck, the almost-smile gone now, his weight still set where Rosa had set it

value.name: Asha stops at half-landing
value.description: Asha pauses at the half-landing with the folder and bank statements held at her side.
evidence: At the half-landing Asha stopped, the blue folder pressed flat against the bank statements at her side
